cases.description: Without a focus query the workflow should still surface structured wins, risks, and next steps.

outputs.summary: Weekly update synthesized from local project evidence about current leadership activity. Primary supporting context came from 1On1 Marcus Devex Lead, 1On1 Sarah Sre Lead.

wins.text: Win: the new developer onboarding checklist cut average time-to-first-commit from 4 days to 11 hours for the last 3 new hires.
Win: the internal API documentation generator shipped and is now producing docs automatically on every merge to main; positive feedback from BU-2 and BU-3 integration teams.
Win: the platform team's internal CLI tooling reduced infrastructure provisioning time by 60%; Marcus is packaging it as a reusable template for other teams.

risks.text: Risk: the vendor auth middleware EOL is causing anxiety among the developer community; engineers are asking whether the new platform will inherit the same dependency; need a clear public statement before it becomes a morale issue.
Risk: Cursor rollout may surface licensing questions — Marcus needs legal sign-off on the enterprise license before the second onboarding session.
Risk: the current alerting thresholds on the API gateway were tuned for 2 BUs; with 5 BUs live, false positive rate has tripled — team is manually suppressing alerts every shift.

next_steps.text: Next: Marcus to schedule Cursor onboarding sessions; share calendar invites by Wednesday.
Next: I will draft an internal communication on the vendor auth middleware migration plan and timeline; circulate to engineering leads before publishing.
Next: Marcus to file the Cursor enterprise license request with Legal this week.
